declaration.preface:
Acknowledging the ongoing degradation of our environment and the depletion of essential resources, Val Organics Private Limited recognized the critical necessity for responsible corporate initiatives. We are resolutely committed to embedding Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles seamlessly into the core of our daily operations.

Within the framework of Val Organics Private Limited, our unwavering dedication to addressing sustainability challenges finds expression in our Holistic Environmental Policy. This underscores our proactive commitment to tackling a spectrum of environmental issues, encompassing energy consumption, water conservation, reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, preservation of biodiversity, adoption of renewable energy, control of air pollution, and the responsible management of hazardous waste. To confront these challenges head-on, we've implemented inventive measures aligned with the core sustainability tenets of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle.

We pledge to not only comply with relevant environmental regulations but also strive for excellence in environmental performance. Through a culture of innovation, adoption of responsible practices, and continual engagement with stakeholders, our objective is to surpass industry standards in environmental sustainability.
declaration.declaration: Val Organics Limited is dedicated to conducting its business in a manner that is environmentally responsible and sustainable. We recognize the importance of protecting the environment and are committed to minimizing our environmental impact throughout all aspects of our operations.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Minimize Atmospheric Emissions & Optimize Resource Utilization
Advance Byproduct and Waste Management Practices
Promote Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services Protection
Minimize Environmental Impacts During Product Use
Minimize Environmental Impacts at Product End-of-Life

Enhance Energy Conservation: We continuously strive to improve energy efficiency by adopting best practices in process design, equipment selection, and operation.
We engage employees in energy conservation efforts through training and awareness programs.
Conduct annual energy audits to identify and implement energy-saving opportunities through FY 2029-30.
Minimize Greenhouse Gas Output: We actively seek ways to reduce our greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions through process optimization, energy efficiency measures, and the use of cleaner fuels.
We collaborate with suppliers and partners to reduce the carbon footprint throughout our supply chain.
Establish a baseline for GHG emissions and develop a long-term reduction strategy.
Safeguard Water Resources: We adopt responsible water management practices to minimize water consumption and ensure responsible wastewater treatment and discharge.
We explore water reuse opportunities and collaborate with local communities for sustainable water management practices.
Implement water conservation measures in all operations and achieve zero discharge of untreated wastewater.
Minimize Atmospheric Emissions & Optimiz: We strive to minimize air emissions, noise pollution, and odor from our operations. We will also optimize resource utilization to reduce waste generation.
We implement best practices for dust control, noise reduction, and odor management. We work with suppliers to minimize packaging waste.
Advance Byproduct and Waste Management P: We prioritize the safe and responsible management of raw materials, chemicals, and waste generated from our operations.
We explore opportunities for waste reduction, reuse, and recycling. We comply with all applicable regulations regarding hazardous waste disposal.
Ensure Consumer Safety & Wellbeing: Val Organics is committed to producing and distributing organic products that are safe for consumers and the environment.
Val Organics actively engage with consumers to build trust and educate them about the safety and responsible use of their products.
To be recognized as a leader in organic product safety and consumer well-being.
Establish a system for handling consumer inquiries and complaints, and partner with industry organizations to continuously improve safety practices and address concerns.
Implement quality control, regular safety testing, comprehensive safety data sheets, and clear ingredient labelling to ensure product safety from creation to consumer.
Promote Biodiversity and Ecosystem Servi: Val Organics recognizes the importance of healthy ecosystems for a sustainable future and commits to protecting biodiversity.
Educate employees on biodiversity and its significance & partner with local conservation organizations or NGOs.
Enhance biodiversity within Val Organics' operational areas and surrounding ecosystems.
Partner with a local conservation organization to protect hectares of natural habitat.
Minimize Environmental Impacts During Pr: We are committed to developing and supplying products that minimize environmental impacts during their intended use.
We provide customers with guidance on the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible use of our products.
We continuously evaluate product formulations and processes to improve environmental performance throughout the product use phase.
Review and improve product sustainability performance at least annually.
Minimize Environmental Impacts at Produc: We are committed to reducing environmental impacts associated with the disposal, recycling, and end-of-life management of our products and packaging.
We promote responsible disposal, recovery, reuse, and recycling practices among customers and other stakeholders.
We continuously evaluate opportunities to improve product and packaging recyclability and reduce waste generation.
We encourage the use of environmentally responsible materials that support circular economy principles.
Conduct annual reviews to identify opportunities for improving product end-of-life management and resource recovery.

policy.monitoring:
Building on Val Organics Limited's commitment to environmental responsibility, transparency, and continuous improvement, this reporting mechanism outlines key components for effectively communicating performance and progress on the established environmental policy.

Val Organics will publish a comprehensive environmental sustainability report on an annual basis.

The report will be available in a user-friendly format, both online and in print upon request.

The report will focus on specific KPIs established for each area of the environmental policy, such as:

Energy consumption and GHG emissions (kWh, tonnes)

Water consumption and wastewater discharge (m3)

Waste generation and recycling rates (tonnes, %)

Air emissions (dust, noise levels)

Progress on renewable energy adoption (%)

Clear definitions and data collection methodologies will be outlined for each KPI.

The report will present a clear analysis of performance against established targets for each KPI.

Areas where targets are not met will be identified, and corrective actions or revised targets will be outlined.

The report will highlight ongoing improvement initiatives and future goals for environmental sustainability.

The report will acknowledge the importance of stakeholder engagement in achieving environmental goals.

It will outline communication strategies for keeping stakeholders informed about Val Organics' environmental performance.

Opportunities for stakeholder feedback and suggestions will be addressed.

Val Organics will consider seeking independent verification of its environmental sustainability report to ensure data accuracy and transparency.

Regular reporting fosters transparency and accountability for Val Organics' environmental performance.

Open communication builds trust and collaboration with stakeholders.

Data-driven reporting allows for continuous improvement by identifying areas for progress.

Reporting facilitates benchmarking against industry best practices and regulatory requirements.

By implementing this robust reporting mechanism, Val Organics Limited demonstrates its commitment to environmental stewardship and empowers stakeholders to track progress towards a more sustainable future.
policy.reviewMechanism:
To ensure the effectiveness and continuous improvement of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.'s Holistic Environmental Policy, the following review mechanism shall be implemented:

The Environmental Manager shall review the Policy at least annually, or more frequently if significant changes occur in regulations, technologies, business operations, or environmental risks.

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including employees, customers, regulators, suppliers, and community representatives, shall be considered during the review process.

Environmental performance data shall be evaluated against established objectives, targets, legal requirements, and industry benchmarks.

The implementation of the Policy and progress toward achieving environmental goals and commitments shall be assessed to identify opportunities for improvement.

Based on the review findings, necessary updates, corrective actions, and enhancements shall be recommended to align with evolving environmental standards, stakeholder expectations, and best practices.

Any revisions to the Policy shall be subject to approval by the CEO of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.

The outcomes of the review process and significant policy updates shall be communicated to relevant stakeholders, as appropriate.

This review mechanism will help ensure that the Environmental Policy remains effective, relevant, and aligned with Val Organics' commitment to environmental stewardship and continuous improvement.
